subject: Waterway information - Shipping Safety Control Zone 15
text:
Waterway information - Shipping Safety Control Zone 15
The Canadian Hydrographic Service has found an uncharted islet on the approaches to Aberdeen Bay at position 63 38.3N 072 11.0w.
Please note that chart 5450 is on an unknown datum.  The position of this Navigational Warning has been scaled to agree with chart 5450.
